name: MIDI Umbrella
description: Declares the `usb` umbrella permission and drives ONLY Web MIDI (navigator.requestMIDIAccess) over it, the way com.natureglass.midisurface does. Web MIDI rides the same usb:hs transport on Switch, so the runtime grants it off `usb`; this must scan GOOD — no peripheral-undeclared and NO declared-unused-peripheral for usb. No network egress.
